articles.title: Crypto market slips even as equities advance. Pump surges on social-media chatter
articles.snippet: With a Fear and Greed index pointing solidly at "fear," crypto prices drifted lower even as stock index futures rose. PUMP's 20% surge was the only real headline in an otherwise quiet session.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Hyperliquid Opens Prediction Markets to Anyone in HIP-4 Upgrade
articles.snippet: Plus, a selloff in Oil has markets looking green into the Monday open. And PUMP is leading all alt movers on the week at a surprising time.

articles.title: Cardano Pumps as Network Moves to Further Decentralize Development
articles.snippet: Input Output is handing its core infrastructure to outside teams as ADA gets a lift from an imminent protocol upgrade.
